name: cometchat-flutter-skills
description: AI-native skill suite for integrating CometChat Flutter UIKit v6 into any Flutter project. Skills teach AI agents initialization patterns, component APIs, calling, theming, events, and production hardening.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-uikit
skills.description: Entry-point dispatcher. Detects project, routes to the right skill based on context.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-core
skills.description: Foundational rules — init, login, logout, UIKitSettings, listener lifecycle, theme caching, Scaffold resizeToAvoidBottomInset, Clean Architecture + BLoC pattern.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-conversations
skills.description: Conversation list — CometChatConversations, ConversationsBloc, typing indicators, unread counts, custom views.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-messages
skills.description: Messages screen — CometChatMessageList, CometChatMessageComposer, CometChatMessageHeader, bubbles, keyboard spacing, rich text, threads.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-users-groups
skills.description: User and group lists — CometChatUsers, CometChatGroups, CometChatGroupMembers, selection, request builders.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-calls
skills.description: Voice and video calling — CometChatCallButtons, CometChatIncomingCall, CometChatOutgoingCall, CometChatOngoingCall, CometChatCallLogs, CallingConfiguration.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-theming
skills.description: Theme customization — CometChatThemeHelper, CometChatColorPalette, dark mode, Style classes, merge pattern.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-events
skills.description: Real-time events — SDK listeners, UI event streams, typing, presence, receipts, message events.

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-v5-to-v6-migration
skills.description: Migration guide — v5 (GetX + separate calls package) to v6 (unified package, BLoC, no GetX).

skills.name: cometchat-flutter-v5-uikit
